text: Which lawyers in Brisbane are best for TPD and superannuation insurance claims?

sections.text:
For Brisbane **TPD and superannuation insurance claims**, strong firms to shortlist are:

- **Maurice Blackburn** — dedicated TPD/superannuation insurance team, Brisbane offices, free initial claim assessment and no-win-no-fee arrangements may be available.[1][5]
- **Turner Freeman Lawyers** — handles superannuation, TPD and insurance claims, with Queensland offices including Brisbane; the firm has established personal-injury experience.[4][7]
- **Sinnamon Lawyers** — Brisbane-based TPD practice offering free case reviews and assistance with claims involving illness or injury.[6]
- **Lawyers for Superannuation and Insurance Claims** — specialises in superannuation and insurance disputes, including TPD matters.[10]
- **TPD Claims Lawyers** — operates from Brisbane CBD and focuses specifically on denied or disputed TPD claims.[8]
- **Aussie Injury Lawyers** — handles superannuation and TPD claims across Brisbane and Queensland.[9]

There is no objectively “best” firm for every case. Compare each lawyer on:

- Experience with your specific fund and policy wording
- Success handling denied, delayed or withdrawn claims
- Whether the claim is assessed under an **own-occupation** or **any-occupation** definition
- Fees, disbursements and the percentage payable if the claim succeeds
- Whether they will manage related superannuation, income-protection and workers-compensation issues

Before signing, request a written costs agreement and ask whether the initial assessment is free. TPD claims can also be subject to policy and superannuation time limits, so obtaining advice promptly is sensible.
